criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: OpenStreetMap way 301932784 is named University Lutheran Church; the official visit page and Purdue archive distinguish the site at 460 Northwestern from Purdue Lutheran Ministry. The 17 transformed OSM vertices and the structural shell bottom ring match with a symmetric Hausdorff distance of 0.00001063 m.

criteria.name: Position, orientation and scale/dimensions
criteria.evidence: The envelope bounds match the source footprint within 0.00000555 m. The local conversion places the outline at campus XY [224.0740593385258, 171.33619923364054]; the road-facing edges were selected using OSM way 932656636 (Northwestern Avenue). The outline is about 29.05 by 30.11 m.
findings: OSM is not a surveyed parcel/wall survey; the official photograph has no camera azimuth, so the photographed facade cannot be tied conclusively to a specific compass edge.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors and roof form
criteria.evidence: The official exterior photo supports three above-grade storeys and a shallow dark roof; the official visit page and Purdue archive record support the basement fellowship hall and third-floor sanctuary. The current model spans -2.67 m to 13.94 m, but the height is explicitly estimated with ±2.5 m uncertainty.
findings: No measured elevation or roof section was found. The shallow roof fall and stepped parapet profile are visual estimates; GIS height/story attributes are not reliable for this property.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances and distinctive architecture
criteria.evidence: The model includes a brick shader with brick and noise nodes, pale masonry courses, dark frames and glazing, nine broad street-facing windows (three bays on each of three floors), the UNIVERSITY/LUTHERAN lettering, Fuel lettering, and storefront canopies. The revised preview is closer to the official image’s three dominant ribbon-window bays and larger centered name sign than the first graded revision.
findings: The visible Fuel sign appears on the central frontage grouping while it sits at the far end of the grouping in the official photo; photo azimuth is unknown, so the precise side alignment is not fully verifiable. Door/storefront segmentation and non-photographed elevations remain schematic or extrapolated.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Fresh-opened Blender 5.2.3 asset SHA d9f259d060cbaca93d9b50c675c2e4089800e0e9c8d55e11f2e7725eab259d18; expected scene/collection present, 540 collection objects and 537 meshes; no materialless meshes, external images, linked libraries or missing library paths. The main structural shell is watertight and has no loose vertices. The source register, raw OSM footprint/road snapshots, official web captures and official exterior image are present, with a dedicated build script and three previews.

findings: OSM is not a surveyed parcel/wall survey; the official photograph has no camera azimuth, so the photographed facade cannot be tied conclusively to a specific compass edge.
No measured elevation or roof section was found. The shallow roof fall and stepped parapet profile are visual estimates; GIS height/story attributes are not reliable for this property.

The visible Fuel sign appears on the central frontage grouping while it sits at the far end of the grouping in the official photo; photo azimuth is unknown, so the precise side alignment is not fully verifiable. Door/storefront segmentation and non-photographed elevations remain schematic or extrapolated.
